title: DecentralizedTwitter
tagline: This project is an demonstration of where social media will be in a couple of years and how it can impact our society with a decentralized networking system.
description: This project combines a regular daily application many of us use and making modifications to it to improve our daily life. This project is a decentralized twitter where users can like, dislike, post, and even tip the author all through their decentralized wallet. This project is the future of social media as more and more people are getting to crypto and more and more people are using social media. We do have some prohibited words.
how_its_made: This project was simple to make and used solidity, JavaScript, and html. The solidity code consist of a variety of function needed for this application and helped to connect with the wallet and other crypto related things.  The JavaScript code is the code that basically connects the solidity code and the html code to make them interact with each other. The html code was just the UI and the style of the application.
